main_text.p: miliæ honorifica mentio instituitur: res ante bene præclareq; gestæ commemoran-tur: vita anteacta laudatur, recensentur honores ac præmia: ingenij præstantia: & id genus alia in medium proferuntur. Vel comparatis atq; exemplis, quibus multi magis quàm vllis moueri rationibus solent: maximè si nostræ illa ciuitatis, gentis, familiæ extiterint. Vel auctoritate, testimoniis, sententiis, doctissimorū & grauissimorum hominum. Vel [illegible, ~9 letters] expectatione, spe, votis parentum, propinquorum, aut aliorum bonorum & honestorum ciuium. Vel studio, atq; solicitudine nostra ac nostrorum. Deinde mouentia[illegible, ~10 letters] quoq; sunt argumenta in exhortatio-monetes sen-tentiæ.nibus necessaria: propterea q; veluti calcaria illa sunt, quibus ad capessendam virtutem resq; præclarè gerendas homines instigantur. Sunt autem sex potissimum motus qui hoc in epistolarum genere requiruntur. Primus spes est & expectatio egregiorum præmiorum, gloriæ, honoris, dignitatis, opum, &c. page.notes: The Greek marginal note beside "tia quoq;" and the Greek word after "Vel" in the text are printed in Greek and could not be read reliably at this scan resolution; they are marked illegible. The Latin note "monetes sententiae." is set in italic and split over two lines in the margin. The line "mouentia" has no printed hyphen at the line end, so it is written whole. Long s has been normalised to plain s throughout.
